decisions.reason: As an adjacent extension of the firm's established coding and marking know-how, the manual laser workstation fits its strong in-house development and service capabilities, though its lighter website presence suggests a somewhat more cautious commitment than the printer launches.

The thermal inkjet printer is very close to the firm's core knowledge base and application expertise, so under strong absorptive capacity the firm is well placed to refine it and commercialize it rather than withdraw it quickly.

The piezo inkjet printer also builds on the firm's existing identification technologies and R&D base, and in a growing industry the firm is likely to keep learning from early market feedback and improve the product instead of dropping it.
